scope: Every retained nonempty issue summary and endorsement item in IL-09 through IL-17, inventoried during repair. Candidate rosters and biographies excluded. Campaign-authored policy statements are verified as positions, not proof of claimed outcomes.
method: Actual source text manually compared per claim. Direct HTTPS retrieval with trusted certificates; primary indexed web content resolved NFIB403 and NRA age-gate sources. No fabricated substitutions.
